requirements.requestedControls: 形式、容量、件数、進捗、取消、再試行
actualMeasurements: Native picker actual File; format/bytes/count; indeterminate and known progress; cancel/retry identity; mixed rejection retains previous exact array and File; picker clears; app rejects stale requestId response.

requirements.requestedControls: ドロップ受付、複数ファイル、受付条件
actualMeasurements: Public ui-dropzone with reactive FormControl instantiated; actual native picker is the keyboard/touch alternative. Drag intake is tested with DataTransfer dispatch and is classified as simulated drop, not an operating-system drag.

requirements.requestedControls: ファイル情報、進捗、個別失敗、削除、再試行
actualMeasurements: Standalone public ui-attachment-list; file name/size/state and null/40% progress; per-file failure; native keyboard cancel/remove/retry; id retained, requestId changes, File retained, removal focus restored.

requirements.requestedControls: 表示対象、ページ、拡大、ダウンロード
actualMeasurements: PDF.js real module Worker paints non-white actual canvas pixels; URL/Blob/Uint8Array; two pages, zoom, rapid updates, native text details, exact PDF download bytes; error/retry and Worker cleanup; named keyboard scrolling surface; sourcekit assets verified by bytes/SHA and HTTP.

requirements.requestedControls: 代替説明、縦横比、収め方、取得失敗、遅延読込み
actualMeasurements: Native image alt/ratio/object-fit/lazy attribute; actual broken URL triggers failure, source replacement recovers. Application alt is preserved through locale switch even when it equals a dictionary key.

requirements.requestedControls: 拡大、回転、前後移動、閉じる
actualMeasurements: Actual modal focus entry/return, previous/next, native zoom range to 400%, 90-degree rotation, Escape close; native scrolling reaches all four rotated edges in both profiles, desktop and narrow 200% RTL.

requirements.requestedControls: 項目、移動、ページ表示、自動送り、間隔、停止
actualMeasurements: Items/pages/buttons and actual native pointer/keyboard/touch controls; 350ms interval tested using browser clock; focus pause/manual Stop preserved; hidden/disabled/reduced-motion/destroy lifecycle; live carousel/slide role descriptions; picker named role=group passes fresh scoped axe.

requirements.requestedControls: 比較方向、境界位置、操作
actualMeasurements: Both directions, native Home/End/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and real pointer .2/.8; actual line/clip follows physical image coordinates, range LTR inside RTL UI; focus/value/DOM preserved on dictionary switch; actual native image error and aria-valuetext translate live without another request.

requirements.requestedControls: 切抜き範囲、比率、回転、確定
actualMeasurements: Native pointer drag and numeric keyboard alternatives; 160x80 source crop produces actual 80x40 PNG with red/yellow pixels and source bounds; ratio 1 and 90-degree rotation; native Bitmap closes and pending Blob result invalidates after actual detach/source/hidden transitions; application Blob URLs revoked.

requirements.requestedControls: 再生、停止、音量、速度、字幕、全画面
actualMeasurements: Actual WAV playback, Stop pause/time0, native volume .25/playbackRate1.5, real VTT showing and cue/source replacement, owner-aware pending play Promise, hidden/disabled cleanup; generated real WebM video plays with videoWidth100, native fullscreen element is ui-video-player; held status/error translates with no new fetch.

Actual engine QR raster independently decoded for 128/256/512 x L/M/Q/H x 4 conditions (48); four rendered native QR screenshots decoded. Eight Barcode formats independently decoded x4 (32); all ten formats actual black/white raster plus format/size/height/moduleWidth/value/description controls. Code128 whole 400px raster and wide native screenshot decode; narrow physical 400px retained inside named local region with key/wheel/touch reach both edges and no page overflow. MSI/pharmacode independent decoding unexecuted; clipped viewport is partial information and is not represented as a full-code decode.
